source_projection.Candidate: existing exact C32 structural and arithmetic checks still normative at frozen SHA39fe63a3d71308fae9482e3203b4f5120c34d796ccd2b755b99a9de902005a87; schema string fields are bounded first, exact constant checks retained in implementation
source_projection.StepReceipt: new proposed A external public serialization, not existing schema3 export. Eligible STEP requires candidate_root_current, returned_receipt_observed true, matching nonnull original candidate/returned receipt IDs and exact candidate/to Root association; any uncertain or unreturned effect remains unavailable. These consistency fields do not authenticate themselves.
source_projection.Custody: original live host retains actual custody/owner objects and independent verification; serialized original associations are consistency-only. Unknown/cancelled/revoked never eligible. Same-pose command duplicate requires actual original duplicate receipt, not equal coordinates.
